title: Under the Surface
body:
Some surfaces are starting to tell a different story.

The clean version might not be the one that lasts.

![Six-view contact sheet comparing mottled rust coverage on pale metal panels, a wheel rim, and a cylindrical metal sample under different angles and lighting.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-07-16-under-the-surface/rust-layer-contact-sheet.jpg)
